_about: Hand-checked Harvard knowledge that the City of Cambridge's property records and Harvard's campus map don't capture. parcels.py --update merges it into data/cambridge-addresses.json. The crew's own list (Settings > Harvard places) still overrides everything here. Researched 2026-10-18 from the FY2026 assessor records, the city's land-use table, The Harvard Crimson, club and Harvard websites; re-check once a year when the new tax data comes out (clubs move).
